title: Stock Buy and Sell
stepTitle: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
category: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
problemStatement: One buy and one sell (sell after buy). Maximise profit, or 0 if none is positive.
intuition: Selling on day i is only ever optimal against the cheapest price seen before i. Carry that minimum as you sweep and every day is answered in O(1).

approaches.title: Brute: all buy/sell pairs
Optimal: track the minimum so far
approaches.idea: profit = price - min_so_far, updated in one pass.
approaches.code:
def max_profit(prices: list[int]) -> int:
    best = 0
    lowest = float("inf")
    for p in prices:
        lowest = min(lowest, p)
        best = max(best, p - lowest)
    return best

approaches.whyWorks: Maximising p[j] - min(p[0..j-1]) over j covers every valid pair exactly once.

commonMistakes: Allowing a sell before the buy by taking global max - global min
Returning a negative profit instead of 0
patternRecognition: "Best pair with an order constraint" -> prefix extremum
followUps: With a cooldown or a transaction fee
